_readme: Human-verified magnet programs. Add one entry per school after checking it against the district's magnet catalog (miamimagnets.org). Leave this list empty rather than guess: schools missing here are reported as 'magnet status not available'. Fields: source_id (county school ID, e.g. '7301') or name; themes (list of strings as the catalog words them); verified_by; verified_on (YYYY-MM-DD); catalog_url (the exact page you checked).

source.title: M-DCPS Magnet Programs catalog (curated by hand)
